in_sanskrit.name: Jharvika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jharvika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jharvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jhar' meaning 'to flow' and 'Vika' meaning 'prosperity'. This name is associated with the Goddess of prosperity and abundance. It is believed that the name Jharvika bestows wealth, prosperity, and good fortune upon the bearer.
